automation_scripts_rules.description: Always include application state reset as first step
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation test cases
rule_definition: WHEN: Starting any automation test execution
THEN: Always include self.fc.reset_app() or equivalent as the first step
IMPLEMENTATION: Execute application reset to clear cache, data, and return app to initial state before proceeding with test steps

automation_scripts_rules.description: Include implicit prerequisite steps for test execution
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases requiring device setup or navigation prerequisites
rule_definition: WHEN: Manual test steps assume a starting state (like having a printer already added)
THEN: Add implicit steps to reach that starting state
IMPLEMENTATION: Include steps like navigate to add device, search and select printer, login, etc. even if not in manual steps

automation_scripts_rules.description: Add supporting validation steps after navigation actions
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases with screen navigation
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing navigation actions that change screens
THEN: Add implicit validation steps to verify the expected screen was reached
IMPLEMENTATION: Insert verify_[screen_name]_screen_title() or similar validation methods after navigation clicks

automation_scripts_rules.description: Split combined manual steps into atomic automation steps
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Manual steps that combine action and verification
rule_definition: WHEN: A manual step combines multiple actions (e.g., 'Click button AND verify screen')
THEN: Split into separate atomic automation script steps
IMPLEMENTATION: Create one step for the action (click) and separate step for verification (assert)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Handle test cases verifying Create Your Own Shortcut functionality
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases of type 'Verify the screen, when user clicks on the Create your own shortcut arrow button'
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases that verify Create Your Own Shortcut arrow button functionality
THEN: You MUST include implicit steps for application reset, device setup, and intermediate validations
IMPLEMENTATION: Include self.fc.reset_app(), device navigation steps, shortcuts screen validation, even if not in manual steps because they are required for test case purpose validation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Maintain proper step execution order
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation test cases
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing automation steps
THEN: Maintain logical order: reset → prerequisites → manual steps → validations
IMPLEMENTATION: Execute steps in sequence with proper dependencies and wait conditions

automation_scripts_rules.description: Use assert statements for final verification steps
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that verify final outcomes
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing verification steps that determine test pass/fail
THEN: Use assert statements to cause test failure if verification fails
IMPLEMENTATION: Use 'assert self.[method].verify_[condition]()' for final verification steps

automation_scripts_rules.description: Include detailed intermediary steps for each script line
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script implementations
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing any automation script line
THEN: Document detailed intermediary steps with step order, action, and technical details
IMPLEMENTATION: Break down each script line into granular implementation steps with wait conditions and error handling

automation_scripts_rules.description: Use page object model methods consistently
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script implementations
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing UI interactions
THEN: Always use page object model methods rather than direct element interactions
IMPLEMENTATION: Use self.[page_object].[action_method]() format for all UI interactions

automation_scripts_rules.description: Externalize test data references
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Automation steps using test data
rule_definition: WHEN: Automation steps require test data (IP addresses, credentials, etc.)
THEN: Reference from external configuration objects
IMPLEMENTATION: Use self.p.[property] or self.config.[property] instead of hard-coded values

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Steps Handling Rule for Test Setup Phase
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All preconditions and setup steps (Steps 1-5) that have no direct script line mapping
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step is marked as 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution' or belongs to preconditions/setup phase
THEN: Classify step as implicit and handle in test setup phase (@BeforeTest or @BeforeMethod hooks)
IMPLEMENTATION: Execute in setup phase, exclude from main test body, document in correlation mapping with handled_by: test_setup

automation_scripts_rules.description: One-to-Many Step Decomposition Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that map to multiple script lines (e.g., Step 6 maps to Line 1 and Line 2)
rule_definition: WHEN: Single test step maps to 2 or more distinct script lines with different purposes
THEN: Decompose step into intermediary sub-steps (6a, 6b, etc.) where each sub-step maps to exactly one script line
IMPLEMENTATION: Create sub-steps with alphabetic suffix, assign execution_order, establish depends_on relationships, classify by purpose (verification, action, supporting)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Supporting Steps for Test Case Purpose Validation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Steps labeled as 'Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation' in test cases of type 'Verify the screen, when the user clicks on Go back button'
rule_definition: WHEN: Executing test cases that verify screen navigation after clicking Go back button
THEN: Include supporting verification steps even if not explicitly mentioned in manual test steps
IMPLEMENTATION: Add Line 1: self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title() before click actions and Line 3: assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_title() for final validation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Script Line Reusability Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Script lines used by multiple test steps (e.g., Line 2 used by both Step 6b and Step 7)
rule_definition: WHEN: Same script line is referenced by multiple test steps in different contexts
THEN: Design automation method for reusability with proper parameterization and context handling
IMPLEMENTATION: Create parameterized methods that handle both back button click and popup confirmation, document reuse in correlation mapping notes

automation_scripts_rules.description: Execution Order and Dependencies Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All intermediary steps within decomposed test steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step is decomposed into multiple intermediary steps
THEN: Assign explicit execution_order and depends_on relationships to ensure correct automation flow
IMPLEMENTATION: Set execution_order (1, 2, 3...), define depends_on with prerequisite step IDs, mark is_blocking: true for critical steps

automation_scripts_rules.description: Atomic Action Principle Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script lines and intermediary steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Creating automation methods for intermediary steps
THEN: Ensure each method represents single, atomic action that cannot be further decomposed
IMPLEMENTATION: Separate verification from action, separate action from validation, create supporting steps for waits and synchronization

automation_scripts_rules.description: Purpose Classification Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All intermediary steps in automation scripts
rule_definition: WHEN: Creating intermediary steps for test automation
THEN: Classify each step with explicit purpose from defined taxonomy
IMPLEMENTATION: Assign purpose field (element_visibility_check, user_interaction, navigation_validation, final_state_validation, etc.) and ensure purpose aligns with step_type

automation_scripts_rules.description: Synchronization and Wait Handling Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All steps involving navigation, popup handling, or dynamic content
rule_definition: WHEN: Step involves page navigation, popup confirmation, or dynamic element interaction
THEN: Include explicit synchronization steps with clear wait conditions and timeout values
IMPLEMENTATION: Create supporting steps for wait_for_navigation, wait_for_element, wait_for_popup with appropriate timeout values (5-30 seconds)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Error Handling and Failure Reporting Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All intermediary steps and automation methods
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing automation methods for intermediary steps
THEN: Include clear failure conditions, descriptive error messages, and diagnostic information
IMPLEMENTATION: Use try-catch blocks, capture screenshots on failure, log step execution status, include element identifiers in error messages

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Isolation and Independence Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test cases with implicit setup steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Test case has implicit steps handled in setup phase
THEN: Ensure complete test independence without relying on state from other tests
IMPLEMENTATION: Implement complete setup in @BeforeTest/@BeforeMethod, create required test data in setup, clean up in teardown, use unique identifiers

automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases involving cancel confirmation dialogs and popup verification

THEN: You MUST include an implicit verification step to confirm dialog appearance before proceeding to dialog interaction

automation_scripts_rules.description: Sequential Action-Verification Pattern for Dialog Workflows
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps involving dialog interactions with confirmation actions
rule_definition: WHEN: A test case involves dialog-based confirmations (Yes/No, OK/Cancel patterns)
THEN: You MUST split the workflow into: trigger_action -> verify_dialog_appears -> interact_with_dialog -> verify_result

automation_scripts_rules.description: Setup Phase Consolidation for Multi-Step Navigation
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases with extensive navigation prerequisites (Steps 1-5 in this pattern)
rule_definition: WHEN: Multiple consecutive test steps are marked as 'Implicit - Handled in test setup/prerequisites'
THEN: You MUST consolidate these into a single setup phase that executes all navigation steps before the actual test logic begins
IMPLEMENTATION: Steps 1-5 should be executed as setup_shortcut_creation_flow() before executing the actual test steps (Step 6 onwards)

automation_scripts_rules.description: Post-Action Implicit Verification for State Changes
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps that expect implicit verification after state-changing actions
rule_definition: WHEN: A test step performs an action that should result in screen navigation or state change
THEN: You MUST include implicit verification of the expected state even if marked as 'Implicit - Verification expected'
IMPLEMENTATION: After click_cancel_shortcut_yes_cancel_btn(), implement explicit verification of shortcuts screen display rather than relying on implicit expectation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Mandatory Intermediary Step Implementation for Page Object Actions
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script steps using page object methods (self.hpx_shortcuts.*)
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing page object method calls like click_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn() or verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title()
THEN: You MUST implement all corresponding intermediary steps including element location, wait conditions, and action verification
IMPLEMENTATION: Each page object method must include: locate element -> verify interactable -> execute action -> wait for response -> verify expected outcome

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Case Context Preservation Rule

automation_scripts_rules.description: Verification Steps Must Include Multiple Validation Phases
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Complex verification steps with multiple expected outcomes
rule_definition: WHEN: A verification step has multiple expected results (like toggle enabled AND button enabled)
THEN: Split verification into separate phases for each expected outcome
IMPLEMENTATION: Split step 7 verification into print toggle verification phase, button identification phase, and button state assertion phase
